title: Night By Day
description: When you start a world you are limited to a 16 by 16 area that you can work with. Every night that you sleep you are given more room to grow and expand depending on how many nights you have slept.
body:
# **Overview**

  This mod tries to fix this by making the player work through their world slowly and use all their assets to their advantage. 

**World Border**
  If you don't know what a world border is it is something that prevents you from attacking, placaing blocks, breaking blocks. Pretty much prevents you from doing anything outside of the world border. When you first start your world you are given 3 wool to help make a bed. You will also see a world border 8 blocks out from where you spawned. This is your 16 X 16 world you now live in. Don't freat though. Every night you sleep the world border expands depending on how many times you have slept.
  Having this set to start out slower help you the player make more caculated desions for what you are going to do but what you are going to spend your recources on. This also helps the later game as when you are 5 days in the next time you sleep the world border is going to expand by 6 blocks!
